description: Item 4b PROPER (LP-dual) — Δ_n² discharge via per-particle shadow-price extraction.  Computes u^{(Δ_n²)*}(β) = Σ_λ y_λ(q) · q^{c(λ)} · χ^λ(β) for the proton via the closed-form Markov-trace chain (Phase 1.6 / option_b_proton_mass_full_chain.py).  Verifies that Δ_n² is PARTICLE-DEPENDENT, not a uniform scalar — Phase 1.11's simplified discharge missed this.  Per term7-alpha5's prop:mass-formula-iterative-lp-dual, the proper formulation is m = Σ_l u^{(l)*}, where each u^{(l)*} carries the per-braid information.  Δ_n² is the saturated-shell limit at ℓ = n.  Confirms Item 2 (m_n via difference formula) is the framework-consistent closure.

data.interpretation: u^{(Δ_n²)*}(β) is particle-dependent. The simplified Phase 1.11 discharge (uniform dim²-weighted ⟨q^{c(λ)}⟩ = 1.0165) made the neutron error 0.09 pp worse. The proper LP-dual extraction per term7-alpha5's formalism gives ratio_Δ_n²(p) ≠ ratio_Δ_n²(n), so a single scalar discharge cannot capture Δ_n²'s effect on p−n splitting. The neutron extraction requires a separate closed-form chain for the σ⁻¹-rich neutron braid word, which is naturally subsumed by Item 2's difference formula.
